limitations: Two development natural tasks are not an unbiased sample or independent qualification.
No claim task/each/OR coverage unless actual output expresses those forms.
Developer reference and review are explicit human-in-the-loop development roles, not formal independent truth.
No generated code, Oracle outcomes, effect claims or Pair research.
metrics: key semantic bindings preserved with exact graph coordinates
frozen primary factors correctly usable / missed / unresolved
all proposed factors source correctness and editability
actual text edits and non-target preservation
procedure: Two natural source tasks: one fresh open extraction each with current ordinary review and existing at-most-one mechanical replacement and one semantic patch. No resampling.

One automatic source-only candidate proposal with existing Qwen Flash settings; no proposal repair. Same retained proposal and exact graphs compiled by current and pre-revision projection. Comparison is projection conditional on this proposal, not a fair standalone proposer experiment.

Developer audits every proposal versus frozen references; exclusions/failures remain. Reference-defined factors missed remain missed. Local per-factor compile diagnostics may localize a failed batch but do not replace the failed automatic batch.

If the full candidate batch compiles and any primary firmware factor passes review, freeze its derived catalog and freshly extract only firmware under that exact catalog. Choose the first usable primary factor in source order size, magic, confinement for one actual REMOVE plus reverse ADD diagnostic. If blocked, report blocked; no guessed states or manual relabeling.

Actual edits use existing mechanism. Developer reviews exact before/after source; post-edit graph if authored is explicitly diagnostic and never an automatic extraction success. Non-target overlap is a retained failure, not permission to remove more text.
Replay original pandoc API negative probes offline. Stop; no model search or repeat-until-success.
